entries.name: Authored gestures (point, shrug, facepalm, hands on head, typing, hold up, thrust prop, clap)
entries.author: Creatorize (built on Quaternius UAL mocap)
entries.credit_text: Gestures built on the Universal Animation Library by Quaternius, CC0
entries.note: Body, legs and breathing come from UAL Idle_Loop / Sitting_Idle_Loop mocap; arms are two-bone IK to authored targets; finger poses are sampled from UAL clips (Punch_Cross fist, Sword_Idle grip, Idle_Talking open). Non-loop clips blend in/out of the idle (start and end on Idle_Loop pose). Recipes: tools/build/recipes.js.

animations.name: G_Point_Forward
animations.use: point at camera/forward (right index finger), blends in/out of idle

animations.name: G_Point_Side
animations.use: point to the character's right side

animations.name: G_Facepalm
animations.use: facepalm (right hand on forehead, head bowed)

animations.name: G_Typing_Standing_Loop
animations.use: typing / pressing buttons at a standing desk (hands at 1.03 m)

animations.name: G_Typing_Seated_Loop
animations.use: typing seated (keyboard at 0.78 m, chair seat 0.45 m)

animations.name: G_Hold_Up_Overhead
animations.use: lift object / sign overhead with both hands, in-hold-out

animations.name: G_Thrust_Prop_Loop
animations.use: thrust a prop toward the lens with the right hand, shakes 2 Hz

entries.name: KayKit Character Animations retargeted to the UE skeleton
entries.author: Kay Lousberg (KayKit); retargeted by Creatorize
entries.credit_text: KayKit Character Animations by Kay Lousberg (kaylousberg.com), CC0
entries.licence_quote: free for personal and commercial use, no attribution required (CC0 Licensed)
entries.note: Baked offline from KayKit Rig_Medium (21 bones, no fingers) onto the 65-bone skeleton with world-space rotation deltas (T-pose to T-pose); fingers stay in rest (open hand), clavicles/neck/spine_02 stay at rest. Clip names prefixed KK_. Hanging arms are pulled 24 deg toward the body (KayKit torso is wider).
